```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(ggtext)
library(ggh4x)

# Source model + analysis + diagnostics scripts
file_sources <- list.files(here("scripts"), pattern = "*.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(file_sources, source))

# Theme
base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey50", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey50"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7)
  )

label_mass <- function(x) paste0("m = ", format(x, scientific = TRUE), " g")
label_f <- function(x) paste0("prey index = ", sprintf("%.2f", x))
```

## Traits

```{r traits}
trait_list <- list(
  largePel = list(
    # Activity metabolism
    a_a = 80, b_R = 0.85,

    # Oxygen conductance fallback (a_O = a_g / hm)
    a_g = 3, hm = 1,

    # Basal fallback via a_M = f_m * a_c
    f_m = 0.1, b_m = 0.75,

    # Encounter
    a_e = 200, b_e = 2/3,

    # Processing capacity
    a_c = 60, b_c = 0.75,

    # Efficiencies
    epsAssim = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.2,

    # O2 kinetics
    K = 2.0,
    h = 2.0,

    # Temperature
    T_ref = 10,
    Q10_m = 2.00, Q10_a = 1.20, Q10_o = 1.50, Q10_c = 2.00
  )
)

tr <- trait_list[["largePel"]]
```

## Grids and helper plotting wrappers

```{r grids}
# Main plotting grids
mass_pair <- c(1e2, 1e4)
T_pair <- c(5, 20)
f_pair <- c(0.2, 0.8)

pO2seq <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.2)
f_seq <- seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01)
Tseq <- seq(0, 25, by = 0.25)

# Wrapper to standardize panel look
panel_raster_contour <- function(df, x, y, z, title, fill_lab,
                                 low = "#7f0000", mid = "white", high = "#08519c",
                                 midpoint = 0, limits = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], fill = .data[[z]])) +
    geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_contour(aes(z = .data[[z]]), color = "black", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.7, bins = 6) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = low, mid = mid, high = high,
      midpoint = midpoint, limits = limits,
      oob = squish, na.value = "grey10", name = fill_lab
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = x, y = y) +
    base_theme
  p
}

panel_raster_seq <- function(df, x, y, z, title, fill_lab) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], fill = .data[[z]])) +
    geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = fill_lab, na.value = "grey10") +
    labs(title = title, x = x, y = y) +
    base_theme
}
```

## A) Oxygen × food limitation over size and temperature (4 panels)

```{r surface-o2-food, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
surf_o2_food <- compute_state_surface(
  tr = tr,
  masses = mass_pair,
  Tseq = T_pair,
  pO2seq = pO2seq,
  preys = f_seq,
  prey_units = "prey_index",
  pair_mode = "cross",
  progress = TRUE
) %>%
  add_regime_labels_ingestion()

surf_o2_food <- surf_o2_food %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(mass, levels = mass_pair, labels = label_mass(mass_pair)),
    T_lab = factor(T, levels = T_pair, labels = paste0("T = ", T_pair, "°C"))
  )
```

```{r fig-o2-food-energy}
p_o2_food_energy <- panel_raster_contour(
  surf_o2_food,
  x = "f_ref", y = "pO2", z = "E_net_norm",
  title = "Available energy",
  fill_lab = "E_avail / Cmax",
  midpoint = 0
) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(mass_lab), cols = vars(T_lab), independent = "none") +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

p_o2_food_energy
```

```{r fig-o2-food-limitations}
p_o2_food_g <- panel_raster_seq(
  surf_o2_food,
  x = "f_ref", y = "pO2", z = "g",
  title = "Oxygen throttling fraction",
  fill_lab = "g = C_real/C_pot"
) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(mass_lab), cols = vars(T_lab), independent = "none") +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

p_o2_food_f <- panel_raster_seq(
  surf_o2_food,
  x = "f_ref", y = "pO2", z = "f",
  title = "Feeding level",
  fill_lab = "f = C_pot/Cmax"
) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(mass_lab), cols = vars(T_lab), independent = "none") +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

p_o2_food_regime <- ggplot(surf_o2_food, aes(f_ref, pO2, fill = regime)) +
  geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(mass_lab), cols = vars(T_lab), independent = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Prey limited" = "#4daf4a",
    "Oxygen-limited processing" = "#377eb8",
    "Co-limited" = "#984ea3",
    "Energetic exclusion" = "#ff7f00",
    "Oxygen exclusion" = "#e41a1c",
    "Unclassified" = "grey70"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Limitation regimes",
    x = "Prey index",
    y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)")
  ) +
  base_theme

(p_o2_food_g | p_o2_food_f) / p_o2_food_regime
```

## B) Oxygen × temperature limitation over size and food (4 panels)


## C) Metabolic allocation diagnostics (oxygen × food)

```{r fig-metabolic-allocation-o2-food}
# Choose one representative mass and temperature for process allocation diagnostics
alloc_df <- surf_o2_food %>%
  filter(mass == mass_pair[2], T == T_pair[1])

plot_metabolic_allocation(alloc_df, x = "f_ref", y = "pO2") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Metabolic allocation | ", label_mass(mass_pair[2]), ", T = ", T_pair[1], "°C"),
    x = "Prey index",
    y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)")
  ) +
  base_theme
```

```{r fig-process-reference}
plot_process_reference(alloc_df, x = "f_ref", y = "pO2") +
```
